description: Turn the VPS firewall on or off and set the default in/out policies. A DROP policy without allow rules locks out SSH. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

policyIn.description: Default policy for incoming traffic no rule matches.

policyOut.description: Default policy for outgoing traffic no rule matches.

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: update_vserver_firewall_options
title: Update VPS Firewall Options
